\chapter{总结与展望}\label{chap:conclusion}

\section{论文总结}\label{sec:summary}

随着大语言模型参数规模的持续增长，微调已成为将预训练模型适配到具体下游任务的关键环节。然而，微调
阶段需要同时维护模型参数、梯度和优化器状态，导致显存占用和计算成本急剧上升，使得高效微调成为制约
大模型广泛落地的核心瓶颈之一。为降低微调资源消耗，以LoRA为代表的参数高效微调方法通过在低秩子空间
中更新参数有效减少了可训练参数量，但其对权重更新施加的低秩约束也限制了模型的优化能力。梯度低秩投
影方法GaLore从另一条路径出发，在不限制参数更新空间的前提下，通过对梯度矩阵进行低秩投影来压缩优化
器状态，兼具接近全参数训练的更新自由度和较低的显存成本。但GaLore需要周期性地对梯度矩阵执行奇异值
分解以更新投影子空间，该操作在GPU上同步执行时会严重阻塞训练流水线，使刷新步耗时膨胀数十倍至数百
倍，成为端到端训练吞吐的主要瓶颈。与此同时，在典型的大模型训练系统中，CPU在整个训练过程中处于低
利用状态，存在大量未被利用的空闲算力，这种CPU--GPU负载不均衡为系统级优化提供了直接切入点。

针对上述问题，本文提出了异步梯度低秩投影方法AsGaLore。该方法将高开销的SVD计算从GPU关键路径卸载到
CPU后台异步执行，并引入投影矩阵延迟更新机制，使CPU侧的SVD计算与GPU侧的训练计算在时间上重叠，从
而消除SVD对GPU训练流水线的阻塞。在理论层面，本文借助Wedin型子空间扰动理论，建立了延迟投影矩阵与
理想投影矩阵之间的误差界，证明了AsGaLore引入的附加误差与GaLore自身周期更新误差处于同一$O(\eta T)$量
级，两者保持一致的收敛趋势。在工程层面，本文通过类继承机制实现投影器的透明替换，通过锁页内存与非
阻塞DMA传输消除GPU--CPU数据搬运瓶颈，并通过CPU核亲和性绑定与批处理型调度策略实现后台计算与前台训
练之间的资源隔离，将AsGaLore无缝集成到现有大模型训练框架中。实验在Qwen3-0.6B、Qwen3-1.7B和
Qwen3-8B三种规模的模型上进行了系统评估，结果表明AsGaLore在IFEval和C-Eval等评测指标基本不变的前提
下，分别实现了1.43倍、1.71倍和2.68倍的端到端训练加速，峰值显存占用最多节省约11.1\,GB；SVD等效开销
消除率达97\%至99\%，更新间隔在较宽范围内变化时模型质量保持稳定，表明该方法在实际部署中具有良好的
参数鲁棒性和工程可用性。


\section{未来展望}\label{sec:future-work}

本文围绕GaLore的SVD计算瓶颈，从CPU--GPU异构协同的视角提出了异步加速方案，并在单机单卡场景下验证
了其有效性。然而，基于梯度压缩的大模型微调方法仍存在若干值得进一步探索的方向，以下从三个方面展望
后续研究。

第一，分布式训练场景下的扩展。当前AsGaLore的设计与验证集中在单机单卡环境中，而工业级大模型训练通
常依赖多机多卡的分布式系统。在数据并行、模型并行或流水线并行等分布式训练范式下，梯度同步、参数分
片和通信重叠机制都会与异步SVD产生耦合。例如，当不同设备上的参数层被分片存放时，梯度副本的收集与
CPU端重组本身也可能引入额外开销；多机环境中CPU资源可能已被数据加载和通信线程占用，后台SVD的调度
空间也会随之减少。因此，如何将AsGaLore的异步机制与分布式训练框架中的参数分片、通信调度和NUMA亲和
性策略联合设计，使其在更大规模训练中仍然保持稳定的加速收益，是一个值得深入研究的方向。

第二，与量化训练和高效SVD算法的结合。AsGaLore当前采用标准SVD进行投影矩阵估计，其计算成本随矩阵
维度增大而急剧上升。若将随机化SVD、截断Lanczos迭代等近似分解算法引入CPU后台流水线，可以在投影质
量损失可控的前提下进一步缩短CPU侧的分解时间，从而放宽重叠条件对更新间隔$T$的约束。此外，量化训练
技术（如4-bit权重量化）可以进一步降低显存占用和访存带宽需求；将AsGaLore的梯度压缩路径与量化训练
策略协同设计，有望在训练资源更为受限的环境下实现更高的综合资源效率。

第三，更大规模模型与更多任务场景的验证。本文的实验覆盖了0.6B至8B规模的模型，而当前主流大语言模型
的参数量已达到数十亿至数百亿级别。随着模型规模进一步增大，SVD计算成本和CPU--GPU传输开销的增长趋
势、投影子空间的稳定性特征以及异步机制的可扩展性都有待在更大规模模型上系统验证。此外，将AsGaLore
推广到预训练、多语言微调、多模态训练等更多任务场景，考察其
在不同训练阶段和数据分布下的适用性与鲁棒性，也是后续研究的重要内容。

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = Inches(13.333)
prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)

# ── Colors ──

ACCENT_BLUE = RGBColor(0x1A, 0x73, 0xE8)
WHITE = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
BLACK = RGBColor(0x22, 0x22, 0x22)

LIGHT_GRAY = RGBColor(0xF0, 0xF0, 0xF0)
RED = RGBColor(0xCC, 0x00, 0x00)
GREEN = RGBColor(0x00, 0x7A, 0x33)
ORANGE = RGBColor(0xE6, 0x7E, 0x22)


def add_bg_bar(slide, color=DARK_BLUE, top=0, height=Inches(1.0)):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(
        MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, Inches(0), top,
        prs.slide_width, height
    )
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()


def add_bottom_bar(slide):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(
        MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, Inches(0), Inches(7.1),
        prs.slide_width, Inches(0.4)
    )
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = DARK_BLUE
    shape.line.fill.background()
    tf = shape.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = "中国科学技术大学  |  计算机科学与技术  |  硕士学位论文答辩"
    run.font.size = Pt(10)
    run.font.color.rgb = WHITE


def add_title_bar(slide, title_text, subtitle_text=None):
    add_bg_bar(slide, DARK_BLUE, Inches(0), Inches(1.15))
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.6), Inches(0.15), Inches(12), Inches(0.7))
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = title_text
    run.font.size = Pt(30)
    run.font.bold = True
    run.font.color.rgb = WHITE
    if subtitle_text:
        txBox2 = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.6), Inches(0.75), Inches(12), Inches(0.4))
        tf2 = txBox2.text_frame
        p2 = tf2.paragraphs[0]
        run2 = p2.add_run()
        run2.text = subtitle_text
        run2.font.size = Pt(16)
        run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xBB, 0xDD, 0xFF)
    add_bottom_bar(slide)


def add_text_box(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18,
                 color=BLACK, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = alignment
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.bold = bold
    return tf


def add_bullet_list(slide, left, top, width, height, items, font_size=18,
                    color=BLACK, line_spacing=1.5, bullet_char="•"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, item in enumerate(items):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.space_after = Pt(font_size * 0.4)
        run = p.add_run()
        run.text = f"{bullet_char} {item}"
        run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
        run.font.color.rgb = color
    return tf


def make_table(slide, left, top, width, height, rows, cols, data,
               header_color=DARK_BLUE, font_size=13):
    table_shape = slide.shapes.add_table(rows, cols, left, top, width, height)
    table = table_shape.table
    for col_idx in range(cols):
        cell = table.cell(0, col_idx)
        cell.text = data[0][col_idx]
        for paragraph in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
            paragraph.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
            for run in paragraph.runs:
                run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
                run.font.bold = True
                run.font.color.rgb = WHITE
        cell.fill.solid()
        cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = header_color
    for row_idx in range(1, rows):
        for col_idx in range(cols):
            cell = table.cell(row_idx, col_idx)
            cell.text = data[row_idx][col_idx]
            for paragraph in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
                paragraph.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
                for run in paragraph.runs:
                    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
                    run.font.color.rgb = BLACK
            if row_idx % 2 == 0:
                cell.fill.solid()
                cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = LIGHT_GRAY
            else:
                cell.fill.solid()
                cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = WHITE
    return table

                      bg_color=LIGHT_BLUE, text_color=DARK_BLUE):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()

    tf.margin_bottom = Inches(0.1)
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]

    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.color.rgb = text_color
    return tf


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Slide 1: Title
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])

add_text_box(slide, Inches(1), Inches(2.2), Inches(11.3), Inches(1.5),

line2.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0x88, 0xBB, 0xEE)
line2.line.fill.background()

info_items = [

slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = Inches(13.333)
prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)

# ── Colors ──
DARK_BLUE = RGBColor(0x00, 0x32, 0x6B)
MEDIUM_BLUE = RGBColor(0x00, 0x56, 0xA0)
LIGHT_BLUE = RGBColor(0xD6, 0xE8, 0xF7)
ACCENT_BLUE = RGBColor(0x1A, 0x73, 0xE8)
WHITE = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
BLACK = RGBColor(0x22, 0x22, 0x22)
GRAY = RGBColor(0x66, 0x66, 0x66)
LIGHT_GRAY = RGBColor(0xF0, 0xF0, 0xF0)
RED = RGBColor(0xCC, 0x00, 0x00)
GREEN = RGBColor(0x00, 0x7A, 0x33)
ORANGE = RGBColor(0xE6, 0x7E, 0x22)


def add_bg_bar(slide, color=DARK_BLUE, top=0, height=Inches(1.0)):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(
        MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, Inches(0), top,
        prs.slide_width, height
    )
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()


def add_bottom_bar(slide):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(
        MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, Inches(0), Inches(7.1),
        prs.slide_width, Inches(0.4)
    )
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = DARK_BLUE
    shape.line.fill.background()
    tf = shape.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = "中国科学技术大学  |  计算机科学与技术  |  硕士学位论文答辩"
    run.font.size = Pt(10)
    run.font.color.rgb = WHITE


def add_title_bar(slide, title_text, subtitle_text=None):
    add_bg_bar(slide, DARK_BLUE, Inches(0), Inches(1.15))
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.6), Inches(0.15), Inches(12), Inches(0.7))
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = title_text
    run.font.size = Pt(30)
    run.font.bold = True
    run.font.color.rgb = WHITE
    if subtitle_text:
        txBox2 = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.6), Inches(0.75), Inches(12), Inches(0.4))
        tf2 = txBox2.text_frame
        p2 = tf2.paragraphs[0]
        run2 = p2.add_run()
        run2.text = subtitle_text
        run2.font.size = Pt(16)
        run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xBB, 0xDD, 0xFF)
    add_bottom_bar(slide)


def add_text_box(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18,
                 color=BLACK, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = alignment
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.bold = bold
    return tf


def add_bullet_list(slide, left, top, width, height, items, font_size=18,
                    color=BLACK, line_spacing=1.5, bullet_char="•"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, item in enumerate(items):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.space_after = Pt(font_size * 0.4)
        run = p.add_run()
        run.text = f"{bullet_char} {item}"
        run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
        run.font.color.rgb = color
    return tf


def make_table(slide, left, top, width, height, rows, cols, data,
               header_color=DARK_BLUE, font_size=13):
    table_shape = slide.shapes.add_table(rows, cols, left, top, width, height)
    table = table_shape.table
    for col_idx in range(cols):
        cell = table.cell(0, col_idx)
        cell.text = data[0][col_idx]
        for paragraph in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
            paragraph.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
            for run in paragraph.runs:
                run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
                run.font.bold = True
                run.font.color.rgb = WHITE
        cell.fill.solid()
        cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = header_color
    for row_idx in range(1, rows):
        for col_idx in range(cols):
            cell = table.cell(row_idx, col_idx)
            cell.text = data[row_idx][col_idx]
            for paragraph in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
                paragraph.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
                for run in paragraph.runs:
                    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
                    run.font.color.rgb = BLACK
            if row_idx % 2 == 0:
                cell.fill.solid()
                cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = LIGHT_GRAY
            else:
                cell.fill.solid()
                cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = WHITE
    return table


def add_highlight_box(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=16,
                      bg_color=LIGHT_BLUE, text_color=DARK_BLUE):

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from lxml import etree

prs = Presentation(r'答辩/模板.pptx')

# Extract theme colors from slide master
master = prs.slide_masters[0]
nsmap = {
    'a': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main',
    'r': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships',
    'p': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main'
}

# Check the slide master background
print('=== Slide Master Background ===')
bg = master.element.find('.//p:bg', nsmap)
if bg is not None:
    print(etree.tostring(bg, pretty_print=True).decode())
else:
    print('No background element found in master')

# Check slide master shapes for decoration elements
print()
print('=== Slide Master Shapes ===')
for sp in master.element.findall('.//p:sp', nsmap):
    name_el = sp.find('.//p:nvSpPr/p:nvPr', nsmap)
    cNvPr = sp.find('.//p:nvSpPr/p:cNvPr', nsmap)
    if cNvPr is not None:
        print(f'Shape: {cNvPr.get(\"name\", \"unnamed\")}')
    # Check fill
    solidFill = sp.find('.//a:solidFill', nsmap)
    if solidFill is not None:
        srgb = solidFill.find('a:srgbClr', nsmap)
        if srgb is not None:
            print(f'  SolidFill: #{srgb.get(\"val\")}')
        scheme = solidFill.find('a:schemeClr', nsmap)
        if scheme is not None:
            print(f'  SchemeFill: {scheme.get(\"val\")}')

# Check theme colors
print()
print('=== Theme Colors ===')
# Find theme via relationships
import zipfile, os
pptx_path = r'答辩/模板.pptx'
with zipfile.ZipFile(pptx_path, 'r') as z:
    for name in z.namelist():
        if 'theme' in name.lower() and name.endswith('.xml'):
            print(f'Theme file: {name}')
            content = z.read(name)
            root = etree.fromstring(content)
            # Find color scheme
            clrScheme = root.find('.//{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main}clrScheme')
            if clrScheme is not None:
                print(f'Color scheme name: {clrScheme.get(\"name\")}')
                for child in clrScheme:
                    tag = child.tag.split('}')[-1]
                    for color_el in child:
                        ctag = color_el.tag.split('}')[-1]
                        if ctag == 'srgbClr':
                            print(f'  {tag}: #{color_el.get(\"val\")}')
                        elif ctag == 'sysClr':
                            print(f'  {tag}: sys={color_el.get(\"lastClr\", color_el.get(\"val\"))}')
            break

# Check slide 1 for pictures (logo)
print()
print('=== Slide 1 Picture Info ===')
slide1 = prs.slides[0]
for shape in slide1.shapes:
    if shape.shape_type == 13:  # PICTURE
        print(f'Picture: {shape.name}')
        print(f'  Position: L={shape.left}, T={shape.top}, W={shape.width}, H={shape.height}')
        print(f'  L_in={shape.left/914400:.2f}, T_in={shape.top/914400:.2f}')
        print(f'  W_in={shape.width/914400:.2f}, H_in={shape.height/914400:.2f}')

# Slide 19 and 20
print()
for i in [18, 19]:

    print(f'--- Slide {i+1} ---')
    layout_name = slide.slide_layout.name
    print(f'  Layout: {layout_name}')

            text_preview = shape.text[:80].replace(chr(10), ' | ')
        print(f'  Shape: {shape.name} -> \"{text_preview}\"')

"""
基于开题PPT模板生成毕业答辩PPT
使用模板的主题色、布局和Slide Master样式
"""
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from copy import deepcopy
from lxml import etree
import os

TEMPLATE = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "模板.pptx")
OUTPUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "答辩PPT.pptx")

prs = Presentation(TEMPLATE)

# Delete all existing slides from template
while len(prs.slides) > 0:
    rId = prs.slides._sldIdLst[0].get(
        "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id"
    )
    prs.part.drop_rel(rId)
    prs.slides._sldIdLst.remove(prs.slides._sldIdLst[0])

# Layout references
LY_TITLE = prs.slide_layouts[0]      # 标题幻灯片
LY_CONTENT = prs.slide_layouts[1]    # 标题和内容
LY_SECTION = prs.slide_layouts[2]    # 节标题
LY_TITLE_ONLY = prs.slide_layouts[5] # 仅标题
LY_BLANK = prs.slide_layouts[6]      # 空白

# Theme colors (from template theme)
ACCENT1 = RGBColor(0x44, 0x72, 0xC4)  # blue
ACCENT2 = RGBColor(0xED, 0x7D, 0x31)  # orange
ACCENT6 = RGBColor(0x70, 0xAD, 0x47)  # green
DK1 = RGBColor(0x00, 0x00, 0x00)
DK2 = RGBColor(0x44, 0x54, 0x6A)
LT2 = RGBColor(0xE7, 0xE6, 0xE6)
WHITE = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
BLACK = RGBColor(0x22, 0x22, 0x22)
GRAY = RGBColor(0x66, 0x66, 0x66)
RED = RGBColor(0xCC, 0x00, 0x00)
LIGHT_ACCENT1 = RGBColor(0xD6, 0xE4, 0xF0)


def set_placeholder_text(slide, idx, text, font_size=None, bold=None, color=None):
    for ph in slide.placeholders:
        if ph.placeholder_format.idx == idx:
            tf = ph.text_frame
            tf.clear()
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
            run = p.add_run()
            run.text = text
            if font_size:
                run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
            if bold is not None:
                run.font.bold = bold
            if color:
                run.font.color.rgb = color
            return tf
    return None


def set_placeholder_bullets(slide, idx, items, font_size=18, color=None,
                            bold_items=None):
    for ph in slide.placeholders:
        if ph.placeholder_format.idx == idx:
            tf = ph.text_frame
            tf.clear()
            for i, item in enumerate(items):
                if i == 0:
                    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
                else:
                    p = tf.add_paragraph()
                p.space_after = Pt(4)
                is_bold = bold_items and i in bold_items
                if isinstance(item, tuple):
                    for seg_text, seg_bold, seg_color in item:
                        run = p.add_run()
                        run.text = seg_text
                        run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
                        run.font.bold = seg_bold
                        if seg_color:
                            run.font.color.rgb = seg_color
                        elif color:
                            run.font.color.rgb = color
                else:
                    run = p.add_run()
                    run.text = item
                    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
                    run.font.bold = is_bold
                    if color:
                        run.font.color.rgb = color
            return tf
    return None


def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18,
                color=BLACK, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = alignment
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.bold = bold
    return tf


def add_bullet_box(slide, left, top, width, height, items, font_size=16,
                   color=BLACK, bullet="• "):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, item in enumerate(items):
        p = tf.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf.add_paragraph()
        p.space_after = Pt(4)
        run = p.add_run()
        run.text = f"{bullet}{item}"
        run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
        run.font.color.rgb = color
    return tf


def add_rounded_box(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=15,
                    bg_color=LIGHT_ACCENT1, line_color=ACCENT1, text_color=DK2):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(
        MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height
    )
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = bg_color
    shape.line.color.rgb = line_color
    shape.line.width = Pt(1.5)
    tf = shape.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.margin_left = Inches(0.2)
    tf.margin_right = Inches(0.2)
    tf.margin_top = Inches(0.1)
    tf.margin_bottom = Inches(0.1)
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.color.rgb = text_color
    return tf


def make_table(slide, left, top, width, height, data,
               header_color=ACCENT1, font_size=13):
    rows = len(data)
    cols = len(data[0])
    table_shape = slide.shapes.add_table(rows, cols, left, top, width, height)
    table = table_shape.table
    for col_idx in range(cols):
        cell = table.cell(0, col_idx)
        cell.text = data[0][col_idx]
        for paragraph in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
            paragraph.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
            for run in paragraph.runs:
                run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
                run.font.bold = True
                run.font.color.rgb = WHITE
        cell.fill.solid()
        cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = header_color
    for row_idx in range(1, rows):
        for col_idx in range(cols):
            cell = table.cell(row_idx, col_idx)
            cell.text = data[row_idx][col_idx]
            for paragraph in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
                paragraph.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
                for run in paragraph.runs:
                    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
                    run.font.color.rgb = BLACK
            if row_idx % 2 == 0:
                cell.fill.solid()
                cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0xF2, 0xF2, 0xF2)
            else:
                cell.fill.solid()
                cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = WHITE
    return table

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════

"""
基于开题PPT模板生成毕业答辩PPT
使用模板的主题色、布局和Slide Master样式

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from copy import deepcopy
from lxml import etree
import os

TEMPLATE = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "模板.pptx")
OUTPUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "答辩PPT.pptx")

prs = Presentation(TEMPLATE)

# Delete all existing slides from template
while len(prs.slides) > 0:
    rId = prs.slides._sldIdLst[0].get(
        "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id"
    )
    prs.part.drop_rel(rId)
    prs.slides._sldIdLst.remove(prs.slides._sldIdLst[0])

# Layout references
LY_TITLE = prs.slide_layouts[0]      # 标题幻灯片
LY_CONTENT = prs.slide_layouts[1]    # 标题和内容
LY_SECTION = prs.slide_layouts[2]    # 节标题
LY_TITLE_ONLY = prs.slide_layouts[5] # 仅标题
LY_BLANK = prs.slide_layouts[6]      # 空白

# Theme colors (from template theme)
ACCENT1 = RGBColor(0x44, 0x72, 0xC4)  # blue
ACCENT2 = RGBColor(0xED, 0x7D, 0x31)  # orange
ACCENT6 = RGBColor(0x70, 0xAD, 0x47)  # green
DK1 = RGBColor(0x00, 0x00, 0x00)
DK2 = RGBColor(0x44, 0x54, 0x6A)
LT2 = RGBColor(0xE7, 0xE6, 0xE6)
WHITE = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
BLACK = RGBColor(0x22, 0x22, 0x22)
GRAY = RGBColor(0x66, 0x66, 0x66)
RED = RGBColor(0xCC, 0x00, 0x00)
LIGHT_ACCENT1 = RGBColor(0xD6, 0xE4, 0xF0)


def set_placeholder_text(slide, idx, text, font_size=None, bold=None, color=None):
    for ph in slide.placeholders:
        if ph.placeholder_format.idx == idx:
            tf = ph.text_frame
            tf.clear()
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
            run = p.add_run()
            run.text = text
            if font_size:
                run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
            if bold is not None:
                run.font.bold = bold
            if color:
                run.font.color.rgb = color
            return tf
    return None


def set_placeholder_bullets(slide, idx, items, font_size=18, color=None,
                            bold_items=None):
    for ph in slide.placeholders:
        if ph.placeholder_format.idx == idx:
            tf = ph.text_frame
            tf.clear()
            for i, item in enumerate(items):
                if i == 0:
                    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
                else:
                    p = tf.add_paragraph()
                p.space_after = Pt(4)
                is_bold = bold_items and i in bold_items
                if isinstance(item, tuple):
                    for seg_text, seg_bold, seg_color in item:
                        run = p.add_run()
                        run.text = seg_text
                        run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
                        run.font.bold = seg_bold
                        if seg_color:
                            run.font.color.rgb = seg_color
                        elif color:
                            run.font.color.rgb = color
                else:
                    run = p.add_run()
                    run.text = item
                    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
                    run.font.bold = is_bold
                    if color:
                        run.font.color.rgb = color
            return tf
    return None


def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18,
                color=BLACK, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = alignment
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.bold = bold
    return tf


def add_bullet_box(slide, left, top, width, height, items, font_size=16,
                   color=BLACK, bullet="• "):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, item in enumerate(items):
        p = tf.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf.add_paragraph()
        p.space_after = Pt(4)
        run = p.add_run()
        run.text = f"{bullet}{item}"
        run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
        run.font.color.rgb = color
    return tf


def add_rounded_box(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=15,
                    bg_color=LIGHT_ACCENT1, line_color=ACCENT1, text_color=DK2):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(
        MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height
    )
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = bg_color
    shape.line.color.rgb = line_color
    shape.line.width = Pt(1.5)
    tf = shape.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.margin_left = Inches(0.2)
    tf.margin_right = Inches(0.2)
    tf.margin_top = Inches(0.1)
    tf.margin_bottom = Inches(0.1)
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.color.rgb = text_color
    return tf


def make_table(slide, left, top, width, height, data,
               header_color=ACCENT1, font_size=13):
    rows = len(data)
    cols = len(data[0])
    table_shape = slide.shapes.add_table(rows, cols, left, top, width, height)
    table = table_shape.table
    for col_idx in range(cols):
        cell = table.cell(0, col_idx)
        cell.text = data[0][col_idx]
        for paragraph in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
            paragraph.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
            for run in paragraph.runs:
                run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
                run.font.bold = True
                run.font.color.rgb = WHITE
        cell.fill.solid()
        cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = header_color
    for row_idx in range(1, rows):
        for col_idx in range(cols):
            cell = table.cell(row_idx, col_idx)
            cell.text = data[row_idx][col_idx]
            for paragraph in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
                paragraph.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
                for run in paragraph.runs:
                    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
                    run.font.color.rgb = BLACK
            if row_idx % 2 == 0:
                cell.fill.solid()
                cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0xF2, 0xF2, 0xF2)
            else:
                cell.fill.solid()
                cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = WHITE
    return table

from pptx import Presentation

prs = Presentation('答辩PPT.pptx')

# For each shape with text, estimate if text likely overflows the shape
# Rough estimation: each line ~ font_size * 1.5 height, each line ~ width / (font_size * 0.6) chars
for idx, slide in enumerate(prs.slides):
    title = ''
    for s in slide.shapes:
        if hasattr(s, 'placeholder_format') and s.placeholder_format and s.placeholder_format.idx == 0:
            title = s.text[:40] if s.text else ''
            break

    issues = []
    for shape in slide.shapes:
        if not shape.has_text_frame:
            continue
        tf = shape.text_frame
        full_text = tf.text
        if not full_text.strip():
            continue

        shape_h = shape.height / 914400  # inches
        shape_w = shape.width / 914400

        # Count lines by estimating wrapping
        total_lines = 0
        max_font_size = 12  # default
        for para in tf.paragraphs:
            para_text = para.text
            fs = 12
            for run in para.runs:
                if run.font.size:
                    fs = run.font.size / 12700  # to pt
            max_font_size = max(max_font_size, fs)
            chars_per_line = max(1, int(shape_w * 72 / (fs * 0.55)))
            lines = max(1, (len(para_text) + chars_per_line - 1) // chars_per_line)
            total_lines += lines

        line_height = max_font_size * 1.5 / 72  # inches
        estimated_text_height = total_lines * line_height
        overflow = estimated_text_height - shape_h

        if overflow > 0.2:  # more than 0.2 inches overflow
            text_preview = full_text[:50].replace(chr(10), '|')
            issues.append(f'  {shape.name}: est_h={estimated_text_height:.1f}in shape_h={shape_h:.1f}in over={overflow:.1f}in \"{text_preview}\"')

    if issues:
        print(f'Slide {idx+1}: \"{title}\"')
        for iss in issues:
            print(iss)
        print()
"
